mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate signals monetary tightening, which raises discount rates and compresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 5-day window, or 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in the unemployment rate below 5% signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 5% in a month
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 20-day window, or the 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite UNRATE falling below 5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate and GDP growth signal conflicting monetary and demand pressures, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 60-day window, or the 60-day returns are not significantly negative despite simultaneous increases in FEDFUNDS and GDPC1.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 2% signals accommodative monetary policy, which boosts equity valuations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 20-day window in late-cycle expansion periods, or returns are not significantly positive despite FEDFUNDS < 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in the industrial production index signals robust supply-side growth, which expands corporate investment and consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 60-day window, or the 60-day returns are not significantly positive despite a sustained upward trend in INDPRO.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening, which raises borrowing costs and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 4.5% in a month
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 20-day window, or the 20-day returns are not significantly negative despite FEDFUNDS crossing above 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in unemployment rates and GDP growth signal a strengthening labor market and economic expansion, which boost investor confidence and drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 20-day window, or the 20-day returns are not significantly positive despite concurrent declines in UNRATE and GDPC1.

mechanism_narrative: In a recessionary regime characterized by high unemployment and rising interest rates, a sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 7% intensifies economic pessimism, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 60-day window in recessionary periods, or returns are not significantly negative despite UNRATE >7%.
